title: Chuck Bryant's Speech from Commencement: Speeches for the Class of 2020
summary: A fake commencement speech for the Class of 2020, delivered by Chuck Bryant as part of the "Commencement Speeches for the Class of 2020" series from iHeartRadio. Chuck acknowledges the cancelled graduations and senior milestones caused by COVID-19, calls the students the "Quarantine Class," argues that disappointment builds resilience, and urges graduates to use the pause to reshape the world into a better, kinder one. The episode opens and closes with ad reads (Metro by T-Mobile, Cal Hope, DirecTV Stream) and an introduction by the series host.

entities.name: Commencement Speeches for the Class of 2020

segments.title: Opening sponsor reads
segments.summary: Ad reads for Metro by T-Mobile's 5G plans, Cal Hope's free holiday emotional support line, and DirecTV Stream.

segments.title: Commencement introduction
segments.summary: The series introduces the virtual commencement for the Class of 2020, noting the traditional graduation was on hold, and introduces Chuck Bryant as speaker.

segments.title: Acknowledging the cancelled senior year
segments.summary: Chuck says the graduates have worked hard for years only to lose graduation, senior events and the final walk out of school, and calls them the Quarantine Class. He admits he uses humor to deflect pain and mentions his niece, friends' kids, and his almost five-year-old daughter whose preschool class is also affected.

segments.title: Disappointment, resilience and the value of pain
segments.summary: Chuck argues life is a mix of sweet and bitter experiences, that sadness and pain have value and produce great art and history, and that the graduates will be better prepared for future disappointments.

segments.title: Using the pause to reshape the world
segments.summary: Chuck says the world has paused, urges graduates to use this time to think about making the world better, rejects returning to the old normal, and calls on young people to lead change by slowing down and being kinder to the earth and each other.

segments.title: Closing remarks and sign-off
segments.summary: Chuck closes by telling the class they were cheated but the experience will not define them, congratulates them, and points listeners to the Commencement Podcast on iHeartRadio.
